title: Encode Once, Answer Many: Internalizing Context via Parametric Flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.38356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are typically adapted to a task either by placing knowledge in the input context, which keeps it external and re-encodes it on every call, or by fine-tuning, which internalizes it but demands a costly round of optimization per task. We aim to internalize the knowledge carried by a context directly into model parameters, without per-task optimization and without keeping the context in the input at inference time. To this end, we propose CLIK, a context-conditioned parameter generator that maps a given context to LoRA parameters for internalizing knowledge in a single forward pass through a Transformer encoder with cross-attention, requiring no test-time gradient updates. Once the generated LoRA is inserted into a frozen base model, the model answers downstream queries from the query alone, having internalized the context into its weights rather than re-reading it. translated_title: 编码一次，多次回答：通过参数化流内化上下文
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常通过两种方式来适应任务：一是将知识置于输入上下文中，这使知识保持在外部状态，并在每次调用时都需要重新编码；二是微调，这虽然能将知识内化，但每个任务都需要一轮代价高昂的优化。我们的目标是将上下文所携带的知识直接内化到模型参数中，既无需针对每个任务进行优化，也无需在推理时将上下文保留在输入中。为此，我们提出了CLIK，这是一个以上下文为条件的参数生成器，它通过一个带有交叉注意力的Transformer编码器，在单次前向传播中将给定上下文映射为LoRA参数以实现知识内化，无需测试时的梯度更新。一旦生成的LoRA被插入到冻结的基础模型中，模型仅凭查询本身即可回答下游问题——上下文已被内化到模型权重中，而无需重新阅读。由于该适配器仅依赖于上下文，它……
tldr: CLIK提出一种上下文条件化的参数生成器，通过单次前向传播将上下文知识转化为LoRA参数并注入冻结的基座模型，从而无需在推理时保留上下文输入，也无需逐任务微调，即可让模型仅凭查询回答问题。
en_tdlr: CLIK is a context-conditioned parameter generator that maps a given context to LoRA parameters in a single forward pass, internalizing knowledge into a frozen base model so it can answer queries without keeping the context in the input or performing per-task fine-tuning.
